service_boundary: Represents the current Tencent Cloud TokenHub service, not the deprecated Hunyuan and LLM Knowledge Engine sales paths, Tencent consumer products, TI-ONE, or individual model publishers.
regional_controls: Tencent documents separate Singapore global, Guangzhou mainland-China, and Silicon Valley US API addresses and scheduling scopes.
retention_controls: TokenHub terms authorize Tencent and applicable third-party model providers to process user inputs; effective retention depends on the selected model, operational mode, and applicable provider terms.
routing: Manual mode uses a customer-selected model. Auto Mode for eligible plans selects a model based on the input; third-party models can be reached through Tencent as an intermediary.
customization: The platform documents pay-as-you-go, guaranteed resources, and exclusive deployment; availability is model- and region-specific.
strengths: A current unified Tencent Cloud service spans Hunyuan and several major third-party model families.
Official docs expose regional endpoints and automatic model-selection behavior.
tradeoffs: Third-party models add publisher-specific terms and downstream processing boundaries.
The predecessor APIs are being migrated, so integrations must target the current TokenHub endpoints.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Tencent Cloud TokenHub API documentation, for Tencent Cloud TokenHub

upstream_disclosure.note: The terms of service state: "by using the Service, you authorise Tencent Cloud to engage the relevant Third-Party AI Model Provider to process the User Inputs you submit to the Service, solely for the purpose of obtaining AI Outputs from that Third-Party AI Model or system on your behalf. Tencent Cloud acts as an intermediary in facilitating such access and does not itself provide, own, or control the AI Outputs."
upstream_disclosure.scope: Tencent Cloud TokenHub terms of service, for Tencent Cloud TokenHub

credential_handling.note: The service offers no customer-supplied upstream-key path: "Authentication method Use the API KEY for authentication via the Authorization: Bearer Header." using a TokenHub-issued key.
credential_handling.scope: Tencent Cloud TokenHub API-authentication documentation, for Tencent Cloud TokenHub

cache_isolation.note: No prompt or context caching feature or scope is documented for TokenHub.
cache_isolation.scope: Tencent Cloud TokenHub API documentation, read for Tencent Cloud TokenHub

vulnerability_disclosure.note: Tencent's security response centre lists in-scope product categories as "(computing/container and middleware/storage/network and CDN/security)" and does not name TokenHub or an AI/ML category.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Tencent Security Response Center scope page, read for Tencent Cloud TokenHub
